desc: When casting an alloyblood hybrid mantra, refresh your critical attack cooldown. Your critical hits with alloyblood weaponry now add composite plasma to your opponent.
name: Plasma Refresh
reqs: 40s BLD, 40s MTL, 60r LHT OR 60r MED OR 60r HVY
additional_info: All of the Alloyblood weapons (Alloyblood Axe, Alloyblood Daggers and Alloyblood Spear) have the default critical attacks of their weapon types.
